网关的 MQTT 端口是多少来着
Gateway 的嵌入式 MQTT broker 监听 19875，HTTP API 是 19876。
那 runtime 的端口呢
Runtime 只监听 localhost 随机端口，由网关反向代理。
为什么 android 打包后图标变回默认机器人了
因为直接跑了 tauri android init，它会重置 gen/android 里的图标；用 build_mobile.ps1。
memory search in chinese returns nothing, is the embedding broken
No — the cosine floor was applied to the fused RRF score, which lives in a different value range. The floor must gate the vector source only.
所以中文查询受影响，英文不受影响？
对，因为英文查询词法命中通常足够强，融合后仍高于阈值。
总结一下这次的检索改动
三句话：全局搜索改用双查询，词法与向量分离；融合结果保留 matched_by 与来源内排名；摘要候选按证据类别筛选。
how do I rotate the provider api key
Use the vault CLI; keys are stored encrypted per agent.
does the desktop app need a restart after that
No, the config snapshot is re-published over MQTT.
